procedure_column: Hu+Gao2008 | PerkinElmer ELAN 6100 DRC | NWU Xi'an

Laboratory.cell: State Key Laboratory of Continental Dynamics, Northwest University, Xi'an (affiliation)
Laboratory.value: State Key Laboratory of Continental Dynamics, Northwest University, Xi'an (affiliation)

Target Material.cell: andesite; basalt; granite; granodiorite; rhyolite; peridotite; dunite; dolerite; diabase; shale; sandstone; limestone; loess; graywacke — the reference materials of Tables 2 and 3, and the upper-crustal samples: PAAS, SCO-1, worldwide loess and Chinese composites of graywackes, shales and granites (§2)

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Aliquot of rock powder -- "Fifty milligrams of sample powder were placed in a home-made PTFE-lined stainless steel bomb"; final solution made up to 50 ml
Sampling Unit Type.value: Aliquot of rock powder -- "Fifty milligrams of sample powder were placed in a home-made PTFE-lined stainless steel bomb"; final solution made up to 50 ml

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Fifty milligrams of rock powder digested in a sealed PTFE-lined stainless steel bomb, taken up and made up to 50 ml with ultra-pure water and Rh internal standard — clean-room conditions (§3.3); for As and Te, 4.80 ml of sample solution plus 0.20 ml ethanol
Sample Preparation Method.value: Fifty milligrams of rock powder digested in a sealed PTFE-lined stainless steel bomb, taken up and made up to 50 ml with ultra-pure water and Rh internal standard

Digestion Acid(s).cell: bomb attack: HNO3 + HF; re-dissolution: HNO3 — §3.3

Digestion Vessel Type.cell: PTFE-lined stainless steel bomb (home-made; stated section 3.3)
Digestion Vessel Type.value: PTFE-lined stainless steel bomb (home-made; stated section 3.3)

Digestion Step.cell: bomb attack (1 ml HNO3 + 1 ml HF, 190 °C for 48 h, then evaporated to incipient dryness and twice taken to dryness with 1 ml HNO3); re-dissolution (1.5 ml HNO3 + 2.5 ml ultra-pure water, capped, 150 °C overnight) — §3.3 numbers five operations; the evaporations carry no attack of their own

Final Solution Matrix.cell: all: 1.5 ml HNO3 and 2.5 ml water made up to 50 ml with ultra-pure water and 0.50 ml of 1.0 µg/ml Rh — §3.3

value.value: 1.5 ml HNO3 and 2.5 ml water made up to 50 ml with ultra-pure water and 0.50 ml of 1.0 µg/ml Rh

Chromatographic Separation Applied.cell: None — the digest is analysed directly (§3.3)

Instrument Manufacturer.cell: PerkinElmer -- "a PerkinElmer SCIEX ELAN 6100 DRC ICP-MS"
Instrument Manufacturer.value: PerkinElmer -- "a PerkinElmer SCIEX ELAN 6100 DRC ICP-MS"

Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configurat.cell: N — an ELAN 6100 DRC; no cell gas or cell mode is described (§3.1)

Analytical Mode.cell: Solution nebulisation (continuous) -- "A glass microconcentric nebulizer (MCN) and a cyclonic spray chamber comprised the sample introduction system, with a typical sample uptake rate of 0.20 ml/min"
Analytical Mode.value: Solution nebulisation (continuous) -- "A glass microconcentric nebulizer (MCN) and a cyclonic spray chamber comprised the sample introduction system, with a typical sample uptake rate of 0.20 ml/min"

Nebulizer Gas Flow Rate.cell: N — 'optimized to obtain maximum signal intensities for Mg, Co, Rh, Ce, Pb and U' (§3.1)

ICP Tuning.cell: Autolens voltages "set by optimizing a solution of 10 ng/ml Mg, Co, Rh, Ce, Pb and U"; "The nebulizer gas flow rate was optimized to obtain maximum signal intensities for Mg, Co, Rh, Ce, Pb and U, while keeping the CeO+/Ce+ and Ce2+/Ce+ ratios below 2.5%"
ICP Tuning.value: Autolens voltages "set by optimizing a solution of 10 ng/ml Mg, Co, Rh, Ce, Pb and U"; "The nebulizer gas flow rate was optimized to obtain maximum signal intensities for Mg, Co, Rh, Ce, Pb and U, while keeping the CeO+/Ce+ and Ce2+/Ce+ ratios below 2.5%"

Instrument Warm-up / Session Duration Li.cell: Partially -- instrument conditioning before tuning is stated: "Drift was minimized by flushing through a rock solution for 30 min before tuning the instrument for a run". No warm-up time after plasma ignition and no session duration limit stated
Instrument Warm-up / Session Duration Li.value: Partially -- instrument conditioning before tuning is stated: "Drift was minimized by flushing through a rock solution for 30 min before tuning the instrument for a run". No warm-up time after plasma ignition and no session duration limit stated

Target Species.cell: Li, Be, B, Sc, V, Cr, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ga, Ge, As, Rb, Sr, Y, Zr, Nb, Mo, Cd, In, Sn, Sb, Te, Cs, Ba, La, Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, Yb, Lu, Hf, Ta, W, Tl, Pb, Bi, Th, U — the forty-eight trace elements of Table 2

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Li, Be, B, Sc, V, Cr, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ga, Ge, As, Rb, Sr, Y, Zr, Nb, Mo, Cd, In, Sn, Sb, Te, Cs, Ba, La, Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, Yb, Lu, Hf, Ta, W, Tl, Pb, Bi, Th, U (ppm) — Table 2; blanks in ppb

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: 114Cd → Cd; 115In → In; 118Sn → Sn — the masses of the other elements are not stated; ¹¹⁸Sn⁺ is measured to correct the Sn interferences (§3.1), and whether it is also the Sn analytical mass is not stated

Dwell Time per Mass.cell: all: 0.15 s — 'peak hopping (one point per peak) was used with a dwell time of 0.15 s' (§3.1)

Number of Scans per Replicate.cell: all: three sweeps per reading and three readings per replicate — §3.1

value.value: three sweeps per reading and three readings per replicate

Wash Time Between Samples.cell: N — 'manual analyses in which care was taken to completely wash-out B and Ta signals between samples' (§3.1)

Signal Collection Mode.cell: Peak hopping, one point per peak — §3.1
Signal Collection Mode.value: Peak hopping, one point per peak

Internal Standard Concentration.cell: 0.50 ml of 1.0 µg/ml Rh in the 50 ml final solution — §3.3
Internal Standard Concentration.value: 0.50 ml of 1.0 µg/ml Rh in the 50 ml final solution

Oxide Production Method and Threshold.cell: CeO+/Ce+ and Ce2+/Ce+ below 2.5%, with the nebulizer gas flow optimised for maximum Mg, Co, Rh, Ce, Pb and U signals — §3.1
Oxide Production Method and Threshold.value: CeO+/Ce+ and Ce2+/Ce+ below 2.5%, with the nebulizer gas flow optimised for maximum Mg, Co, Rh, Ce, Pb and U signals

Drift Correction Method.cell: Rh internal standard, and a calibration solution analysed repeatedly as a drift monitor over the run — drift minimised by flushing a rock solution for 30 min before tuning (§3.1)
Drift Correction Method.value: Rh internal standard, and a calibration solution analysed repeatedly as a drift monitor over the run

Calibration Strategy per Target Species.cell: all: calibration solution, with Rh as internal standard — 'repeatedly analyzing a calibration solution as a drift monitor' (§3.1); its composition is not stated

value.value: calibration solution, with Rh as internal standard

Interference Correction Method.cell: 114Cd, 115In: calibrated through the measurement of 118Sn+; other: N — §3.1

Memory Effect Mitigation.cell: Alternating 5% HNO3 + 0.1% HF and 3% HNO3 washout for B and Ta (stated section 3.1)
Memory Effect Mitigation.value: Alternating 5% HNO3 + 0.1% HF and 3% HNO3 washout for B and Ta (stated section 3.1)

Uncertainty Level.cell: RSD% -- "The RSD is the relative standard deviation in percent"; n = 4-7 per reference material
Uncertainty Level.value: RSD% -- "The RSD is the relative standard deviation in percent"; n = 4-7 per reference material

Calibration Factor and Determination Met.cell: N — 'The isotope interferences of 114,115Sn+ on 114Cd+ and 115In+ were calibrated through the measurement of 118Sn+' (§3.1); no factor is stated

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially -- replicate counts stated per reference material (n = 6, 5, 7, 4, 4; blanks n = 5). No acceptance or rejection rule, and no acquired-versus-included count, stated
Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.value: Partially -- replicate counts stated per reference material (n = 6, 5, 7, 4, 4; blanks n = 5). No acceptance or rejection rule, and no acquired-versus-included count, stated

Combination Method.cell: all: over the replicate analyses of each reference material — the statistic is not named; Table 2 gives n and 'RSD%'. The upper-crust samples are physical composites, not averages of analyses

value.value: over the replicate analyses of each reference material

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: AGV-1, BHVO-1, G-2, GSR-5, SCO-1, JP-1, DTS-1, BHVO-2, BIR-1, JB-3, GSR-3, DNC-1, W-2, AGV-2, BCR-2, JA-3, GSR-2, JG-3, GSR-1, RGM-1, GSR-4, SGR-1, GSR-6 — five in Table 2 for accuracy and precision; eighteen more in Table 3 for Mo, Cd, In, Sn, Sb, W, Tl, Bi, As and Te (§3.4)

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Within-Session Analytical Precision and.cell: AGV-1, BHVO-1, G-2, GSR-5, SCO-1 [all: RSD of n = 4–7 analyses, usually <8%] — Table 2 and §3.4; whether the replicates share a session is not stated

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: AGV-1, BHVO-1, G-2, GSR-5, SCO-1 [all: agreement with GeoReM preferred values (AGV-1, BHVO-1) and Govindaraju 1994 (G-2, GSR-5, SCO-1), better than 8% for most elements]; JP-1, DTS-1, BHVO-2, BIR-1, JB-3, GSR-3, DNC-1, W-2, AGV-2, BCR-2, JA-3, GSR-2, JG-3, GSR-1, RGM-1, GSR-4, SGR-1, GSR-6 [Mo, Cd, In, Sn, Sb, W, Tl, Bi, As, Te: reasonable agreement with Govindaraju 1994 and GeoReM] — Tables 2 and 3, §3.4

value.value: agreement with GeoReM preferred values (AGV-1, BHVO-1) and Govindaraju 1994 (G-2, GSR-5, SCO-1), better than 8% for most elements
reasonable agreement with Govindaraju 1994 and GeoReM

Additional Notes.cell: Auto lens voltages optimised on a 10 ng/ml Mg, Co, Rh, Ce, Pb and U solution; As and Te measured in 4.80 ml sample solution plus 0.20 ml ethanol; HF boiled before sub-boiling distillation to remove volatile As — §3.1, §3.2, §3.3
Additional Notes.value: Auto lens voltages optimised on a 10 ng/ml Mg, Co, Rh, Ce, Pb and U solution; As and Te measured in 4.80 ml sample solution plus 0.20 ml ethanol; HF boiled before sub-boiling distillation to remove volatile As
